reason: The power pallet is buried, so using the winch there seems like a direct way to free the array.
expectation: I expect the winch to pull the pallet or array free of the dust, though it may only be a first step.

alternatives.reason: The service tool might open the shipping frame, but the buried pallet seems more directly connected to the goal.

effect: The array is recovered, but its narrow brackets need stable feet before it can power the cabin. The shipping frame appears to supply the material.
reaction: I like that the loose ground creates a practical reason to reuse the frame.
reason: The service tool and shipping frame are the only available combination, and the result suggests the frame can provide feet for the array.
expectation: I expect to salvage usable pieces from the frame, though they may need further work before becoming feet.

effect: The shipping frame yielded metal stock that the service tool can shape into supports, confirming how it can help stabilize the array.
reaction: I like the practical reuse of the shipping braces, though this next step is the only available combination.
reason: Combining the stock with the recovered array seems like the way to make its broad feet.
expectation: I expect to fit the array with supports that spread its weight on the loose ground, though it may still need a power connection.

effect: The metal stock made the array stand, so it appears ready for a power connection.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the salvaged material become a usable support.
reason: The power lead is the only available combination and seems like the natural way to connect the array to the cabin.
expectation: I expect the lead to connect the array to the cabin, though another step may be needed to supply power.

effect: The power lead completed the solar power rack, and the heater now draws from the array instead of the emergency battery. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the cabin running on the array and the salvaged frame serving as its feet.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the array stand with salvaged metal was most worthwhile: the loose ground gave the wide supports a clear practical purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the frame into stock felt a little procedural because it was the only available combination, though its purpose was clear.

surprise.text: I had not expected the shipping frame to provide broad feet for the array; that detail made the setting's loose ground matter.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The later combinations were the only available choices, but each had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the expedition develops and whether future constructions build on similarly practical constraints.
